pages.text: “Deep roots, sweet taste, soothing the throat, neutralizing toxins, and dispelling seasonal chills.”$(br2)Licorice is a drought-resistant herbaceous plant, renowned for its sweet roots and powerful medicinal properties. Whether blended into tea or used as a remedy, licorice has long been a staple in both traditional medicine and therapeutic cuisine.

Wild licorice is commonly found in arid environments, primarily thriving in deserts and savanna regions. Travelers can locate wild licorice in these biomes and collect its seeds for artificial cultivation, ensuring a steady supply of this valuable herb.

Once mature, licorice plants yield both licorice roots and additional seeds for further cultivation.$(br)The roots are rich in medicinal compounds, making them an essential ingredient in various teas and herbal preparations. Due to its drought resistance, licorice serves as an excellent emergency crop for travelers on long journeys.
